items.context: @BritishHodl (106.845 seguidores): "DCA-in Bitcoin is for the un-convicted or mentally weak. Professionals stack cash and deploy at key moments. Like the 200WMA." (cita otro post). Post de ~20 min con 26 likes, 4 respuestas y 2.228 vistas, creciendo rápido. Ángulo: media de 200 semanas como zona de compra frente al DCA.
items.suggested_text:
The 200WMA is a solid zone to deploy into, but "key moment" hides the hard part. The line keeps moving while you wait, and price doesn't touch it and bounce on schedule: it can sit below it for weeks while the average itself drifts. Waiting in cash is a timing bet with its own cost, and most people only measure it in hindsight.

That's why I treat the 200WMA as one input, not a trigger. In my Market Temperature index it's a quarter of the reading, next to MVRV, drawdown from the high and volatility-adjusted momentum, because any single line can stay "cheap" longer than conviction lasts.

DCA and a cash reserve aren't really opposites either. The interesting question is how much of each, and that answer says more about the person holding the cash than about the chart.
